extracted.intended_audience: healthcare professionals, researchers, students and policy-makers learning to appraise and use health evidence (users of CASP training)
extracted.subtask_description: A bundled set of training modules and checklists from the Critical Appraisal Skills Programme (CASP) covering how to find, appraise, interpret and act on health evidence across study designs including RCTs, cohort studies, systematic reviews and qualitative research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to Critical Appraisal
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview introduction to the principles and purpose of critical appraisal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Challenges using evidence to change practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Topics addressing barriers and challenges when attempting to translate evidence into clinical practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: 5 steps of evidence-based practice
rubrics_metrics.description: The five-step process framework for practising evidence-based medicine (formulate, search, appraise, apply, evaluate).

rubrics_metrics.name: Developing critical appraisal skills
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance and skill-building for evaluating the trustworthiness and relevance of research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrating and acting on the evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles and approaches for applying appraisal results into decision-making and practice change.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Critical Appraisal Skills Programme (CASP)
rubrics_metrics.description: The overall programme framework and purpose (CASP) for providing appraisal checklists and training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Finding & Searching for Evidence Module
rubrics_metrics.description: Module focused on locating relevant evidence in databases and other sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formulating a Clinical Question
rubrics_metrics.description: How to construct an answerable clinical or policy question to guide searching and appraisal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Searching Databases
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical techniques for database searching to find relevant studies and reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstration of a search
rubrics_metrics.description: Worked demonstration showing how to carry out a literature search in practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Study Designs
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of different study designs used in health research and their implications for inference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to study designs
rubrics_metrics.description: Basic primer on the common study designs and what questions they can answer.

rubrics_metrics.name: What is the ‘best available evidence'?
rubrics_metrics.description: Discussion of how to judge what constitutes the best available evidence for a question.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hierarchy of evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Explanation of the relative strengths and weaknesses of evidence types (e.g., RCTs, observational studies, qualitative).

rubrics_metrics.name: Typologies of evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Different classifications and types of evidence used in healthcare decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Different types of study designs
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed descriptions distinguishing study designs (e.g., RCT, cohort, case-control, qualitative).

rubrics_metrics.name: Deciphering the study design
rubrics_metrics.description: How to identify and interpret the design used in a particular research paper.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to the critical appraisal of Randomised Controlled Trials (RCTs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles and key appraisal points when evaluating RCTs.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to use a CASP Randomised Controlled Trial (RCT) checklist
rubrics_metrics.description: Instruction on applying the CASP RCT checklist to assess trial quality and reliability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Making Sense of results: Measures of Effectiveness in Randomised Controlled Trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Interpreting effect measures and results commonly reported in RCTs (e.g., risk ratios, risk difference, NNT).

rubrics_metrics.name: Is the Evidence Useful? – Introduction to critical appraisal of systematic reviews with meta-analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Introductory guidance for appraising systematic reviews and meta-analyses for usefulness and validity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Is the Evidence Useful? – Quality markers of systematic reviews with meta-analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Key quality markers to look for when judging systematic reviews (e.g., comprehensive search, selection bias, heterogeneity handling).

rubrics_metrics.name: Is the Evidence Useful? - Making sense of results (systematic reviews)
rubrics_metrics.description: Interpreting pooled estimates, heterogeneity, and the applicability of meta-analysis findings.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to use a CASP Checklist – Systematic Review with Meta-analysis - Randomised Controlled Trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Applying the CASP checklist tailored for systematic reviews that include RCT evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to use a CASP Checklist – Systematic Review with Meta-analysis - Observational Studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Using the CASP checklist for systematic reviews that synthesize observational study designs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to critical appraisal of Cohort Studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Core appraisal considerations specific to cohort study design (e.g., selection, confounding, outcome measurement).

rubrics_metrics.name: Commonly used effect measures (cohort studies)
rubrics_metrics.description: Explanation of effect measures typically reported in cohort studies (e.g., relative risk, hazard ratios).

rubrics_metrics.name: Interpreting effect measures (cohort studies)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on interpreting magnitude, precision, and clinical relevance of reported effect measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to use a CASP Checklist – Cohort Studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Applying the CASP cohort-study checklist to assess bias, confounding and result validity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Using qualitative research in policy and practice
rubrics_metrics.description: How qualitative evidence can inform policy and practice decisions and where it fits among evidence types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to qualitative Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Fundamentals of qualitative study designs, methods and their appropriate uses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality assessment of qualitative research
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and considerations for judging trustworthiness, credibility and rigour in qualitative studies.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to use a CASP Checklist – Qualitative research
rubrics_metrics.description: Applying the CASP qualitative checklist to evaluate methodological quality and relevance of qualitative studies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bundle Contents / Showcase courses
rubrics_metrics.description: Listing of included courses, digital downloads and coaching available as part of the CASP bundle.
